description:
Cast a copy of Rejoinder by paying {1}{W}, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Rejoinder, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the newest copy of Rejoinder, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Dual Casting
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness
